review_scope: Exact-hash incremental successor to the v0.5 imagery contract. Seven projects inherit the default not-reviewed outcome. Undheim records only identity-bound contractor-published drone context: it is not independent imagery verification and is never used for geometry, status, capacity, progress, building count, or any other core claim. The v0.6 publisher-context record type has no blind ID, queue ID, comparison hash, or visual verdict because those fields are inapplicable rather than missing.

records.identity_binding_basis: The pinned bridge directly binds the v97 Undheim project UUID to its campus through the exact v14 project_targets relationship and retains the Backe page's compact project, client, contractor, and imagery facts. This binds publisher context to the project without treating the media as independent evidence.
records.semantic_scope: Backe-published contractor drone photographs are retained only as source-linked construction context. No image bytes are redistributed, no independent satellite or aerial review exists, and no visual inference enters the core.
